game_title: Nested Maze – Coral Reef Shallows Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Nested Maze: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the route_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ship's hull using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ship's hull reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the ship's hull is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Nested Maze
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Maze' (Week 3 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Coral Reef Shallows'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how route_score changes.
